# Erson Studio — Full Brand & Technical Context Document

## Overview
Erson Studio (operated by Diwash Ghimire, known professionally as Erson) is a specialized video editing and brand content strategy consultancy. With a background in mainstream media production and 3+ years of professional freelance experience, Erson specializes in post-production frameworks that maximize viewer retention and compound brand equity.

## Primary Services

### 1. Content Strategy
- **Audience & Positioning**: Identifying content angles, defining brand voice, and establishing video formats.
- **Scripting & Structure**: Structuring hooks, body content, pattern interrupts, and calls-to-action to minimize viewer drop-off.
- **Content Systems**: Developing scalable, repeatable frameworks for monthly video output.

### 2. Video Production & Post-Production
- **Retention Editing**: Fast-paced motion cuts, dynamic lower thirds, text animations, and visual pattern interrupts every 3 to 5 seconds.
- **Color Grading**: Node-based color correction, skin tone balancing, and custom LUT application in DaVinci Resolve.
- **Sound Design**: Multi-layer audio mixing, risers, ambient textures, and sound FX synchronization.
- **Motion Graphics**: Title animations, logo stingers, and visual overlays in Adobe Premiere Pro & After Effects.

### 3. Content Partnership (Retainers)
- Dedicated monthly post-production partnership.
- High-volume content editing for YouTube, Shorts, Reels, TikTok, and B2B commercial campaigns.
- Direct creative direction to ensure visual and narrative consistency across all releases.

## Verified Results & Case Studies

### CG Communications Case Study
- **Challenge**: Low viewer retention on long-form content.
- **Strategy**: Introduced 3-second kinetic text hooks, visual pattern interrupts, and custom color grading.
- **Result**: Scaled channel impressions from 8,000 to over 10,000,000+ (10M+) monthly views with an 85% average retention rate.

### Kantipur Media Group Partnership
- Handled post-production edits for mainstream broadcasting and digital video channels.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### Q: What is included in a Content Partnership retainer?
A: Content Partnership retainers include end-to-end post-production for a fixed monthly volume of videos (e.g. 4-8 long-form videos or 15-30 short-form reels). This includes script polishing, retention editing, motion graphics, custom color grading, sound design, thumbnail strategy, and ongoing content review.

### Q: How long does a retention video edit take?
A: Turnaround times depend on project length and complexity. Typically, short-form videos (Reels/Shorts) take 24–48 hours, while long-form YouTube or commercial edits take 3–5 business days. Retainer clients receive priority turnaround schedules.

### Q: What is the difference between a project rate and a monthly retainer?
A: One-off project rates cover a single video edit with pre-defined revision rounds. A monthly retainer provides a dedicated production capacity, lower per-video costs, faster turnaround, and long-term brand strategy integration.

### Q: Which software pipeline does Erson Studio use?
A: Erson Studio uses a hybrid workflow: Adobe Premiere Pro & After Effects for cutting, compositing, and motion graphics, combined with DaVinci Resolve Studio for high-end color grading and final master exports.
